limits: Browser replay used actual recorded drone images and real CSRT, with camera acknowledgements simulated at 70 ms. It is not a closed-loop live-flight measurement.
Grounded camera verification measures the actual simulator API, not following a live moving person.
CSRT can drift or lose its object. After the mission SAM session closes, genuine loss requires a new detection; reopening or switching the video does not restore the old worker.
Only the viewed drone receives this browser-driven camera guidance; unattended four-drone camera following is not implemented.
